approvalScope: Official Building PDF construction-page reference only; NOT a certified complete-model WebP
description: Two source-limited, owner-authorized full-page official PDF references with five explicitly classified assessment questions each. Existing 39 approved Wix WebPs and 195 independently verified checklist questions are unchanged.

entries.notice: Original page 3 is a cropped final optimized step, not a verified full-model image. Page 1 predates the final front square sensor module. Consult all three pages.

questions.text: Have you followed all three pages of the Optimized Scorpion Building manual rather than stopping at the earlier page-1 overview?
Is the front square sensor module attached in the position depicted on the official final optimized construction page?
Are the additional optimized attachments secured without loose connectors?
During a gentle manual check, can the legs, claws and tail move without binding or coming loose?
Have you compared your completed build with every original optimized-construction page and fixed any missed steps?

entries.notice: Original page 14 depicts a magnified partial assembly, not the entire completed robot. Compare all 14 original Building pages to check the full model.

questions.text: Have you completed all construction steps through page 14, rather than stopping at an earlier subassembly?
Are the controller, camera or sensor, and finger mechanisms securely attached to their supports?
Can the upright finger-like mechanisms move freely without rubbing or disconnecting?
Have you compared your complete build with all official steps instead of treating the cropped page-14 detail as a full-model photo?
Are all electrical connections and mechanical fasteners secure before testing the assembled robot?
